sloka: अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वान्नयतु नो भवान् ।उद्युक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनानि नगराणि च ।। ६.१२५.२१ ।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṁ gantumicchāmaḥ sarvānnayatu no bhavān ।udyuktā vicariṣyāmo vanāni nagarāṇi ca ।। 6.125.21 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Vanaras had spoken in that way, Rama replied to Sugriva, Vibheeshana and Vanaras as follows.
